Phone app update. The watch app is unchanged from 2.2 (both files are attached for convenience).

- New: "Default for new apps" in settings now has three choices: Show (buzz and show on the watch), Silenced (show without buzzing) or Hidden (keep off the watch entirely). You can still set each app separately on the Apps screen.

If you are coming from a version older than 2.2, install both files.
